overview_description.description:
VGS is the World's Leader in Payment Tokenization. We are trusted by Fortune 500 organizations, including merchants, fintechs, and banks, to store and enrich sensitive payment data across cards, bank accounts, and digital wallets. With over 4 billion tokens managed globally, VGS offers a solutions suite of a composable Card Management Platform, PCI-compliant Vault, and network value-added services like Network Tokens, Account Updater, and Card Attributes.

Our solutions boost revenue with higher authorization rates, fraud reduction, and operational efficiencies while seamlessly integrating with existing tech stacks. We store 70% of all US cards and solve critical payment acceptance challenges, including multi-PSP management, orchestration enablement, PCI compliance, and PII protection. VGS empowers clients with ownership, control, and insights into payment data, elevating growth and user experiences across industries.

Learn more at www.vgs.io.

product.name: VGS Vault Platform
product.description: A PCI-compliant vault platform that tokenizes and securely stores sensitive payment and personal data, enabling businesses to operate on tokenized data instead of raw data.

product.name: Credential Management Platform
product.description: A platform to manage payment credentials including network tokens, account updater, wallets, and card attributes through a unified API.

product.name: Network Tokens
product.description: Merchant-specific tokens issued by card networks to replace primary account numbers for payment processing and fraud mitigation.

product.name: Account Updater
product.description: A service that updates vaulted payment card information automatically to reduce failed transactions and increase authorization rates.

product.name: Card Attributes Service
product.description: A service providing detailed card information through tokenized lookups beyond basic BIN data to optimize payment processes and customer programs.

product.name: Digital Wallet Payments Management
product.description: A solution to centrally manage digital wallet payments by tokenizing and storing DPANs, enabling secure processing across multiple PSPs.
